extracted.intended_audience: readers and researchers seeking information about John Milton and his works (general public, students, scholars)
extracted.subtask_description: A Wikisource author page listing John Milton's works (poetry, prose, posthumous works, individual poems, sonnets, collected works) with publication notes and authority-control metadata. It serves as a bibliographic/index page rather than giving evaluative criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public domain status of works
rubrics_metrics.description: Some or all works by this author were published before January 1, 1931, and are in the public domain worldwide because the author died at least 100 years ago.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Translations or editions published later may be copyrighted. Posthumous works may be copyrighted based on how long they have been published in certain countries and areas.
